name: markdown-preview
description: MCP server for markdown to PDF/HTML/PNG conversion. PDF engine absorbed from @amitdevx/md2pdf: supports Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, syntax highlighting, callouts, TOC, page numbers, and 19 themes (14 plugin themes and 5 md2pdf built-ins) plus custom CSS themes. Exposes 3 tools: markdown_to_pdf, markdown_to_html, markdown_to_png.
